review_findings.fit_scope_and_recipe: The binder appends --valid-fold 0 to the V4 profile argv before embedding it. The remote guard requires the current fold0 path, train+valid, fold 0, seed 3, the H384x2 23-output model, strict FP32 Muon-all flags, exact WMSE/aux/propensity settings, grad-stats, six max batches (two warmup plus four measured), and no evaluation during fit. Its exact-option allowlist excludes heldout-valid inclusion and unreviewed auxiliary/objective flags.
review_findings.prior_valid_fold_issue: The earlier remote template required --valid-fold 0 while the V4 argv omitted it. The current local binder explicitly appends that pair before payload construction; the remote guard then validates it. This resolves the observed mismatch without changing the scientific recipe.
review_findings.resource_and_output_gates: The remote guard requires the two-CPU aggregate campaign slice and headroom, empty populated campaign descendants, selected-GPU identity/free-memory reservation while preserving foreign processes, physical scratch, a fresh source/packet/output/run destination, and uses one CPU, an 8 GB worker memory maximum, no swap, and a 1200-second runtime limit. The profile is fit-only and does not retain a checkpoint or quality score.
review_findings.source_and_prerequisite: The binder pins the published af21d6d8 source manifest (164 files), cold-import receipt (99 runtime modules, five entrypoints, no read-sentinel calls), V4 profile binding, source publication receipt, exact current F0 split, and the accepted terminal propensity verification/checkpoint identities. The remote guard rechecks the staged file set and bytes, verification/acceptance/launch/stop chain, source data alias/stat map, and checkpoint bytes before profile admission.

scope: Focused static prelaunch review of the bounded native teacher-profile admission, its current binder, and the verified propensity prerequisite. No SSH, remote command, profile run, data-array read, model load, or test rerun was performed.
